parameters.query: SELECT t.id AS tid, t.name AS tname, t.sport, t.status, t.scoring_pin, t.organizer_user_id, (SELECT id FROM app_users WHERE phone = $2) AS uid, (SELECT is_active FROM app_users WHERE phone = $2) AS active FROM tournament_web_links l JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = l.tournament_id WHERE l.slug = $1
